_comment: Frozen per-file max-lines ceilings — the size-ratchet baseline (code-quality-architecture-1 + -3). SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: eslint.config.js generates a per-file `max-lines` override from each entry (replacing the old `max-lines: off` grandfathers, which allowed UNBOUNDED growth — pulseKernel grew +28% before this froze it), and tests/lint/sizeBaseline.test.js keeps this map HONEST. Every value is the file's CURRENT effective line count (eslint max-lines, skipBlankLines+skipComments) frozen 2026-07-16. SHRINK-ONLY: to shrink a file, LOWER its number here (the win is then locked); a file that grows past its number REDS eslint; a file that falls under its LAYER ceiling (600 components/src-root-jsx, 800 everywhere else) must have its entry DELETED (the house test demands it). Never RAISE a number and never ADD a file without a decomposition-is-infeasible reason — these are burn-down candidates, not a licence to grow. Keys are repo-relative paths. This _comment key is ignored by both consumers.

This file IS that bank, so the banked ruling is recorded here mechanically instead of being bypassed at the hook. Measured 2026-08-03 with eslint's own Linter under the enforcer's rule: 18 files exceeded their layer ceiling at HEAD eea5a6c6 while only 12 were baselined — the ratchet had been broken repo-wide for several waves because lint-staged lints only STAGED files, so a lane that never stages an over-ceiling file commits happily past a red ratchet. RE-FROZEN at measured tree size: applyWorldPulse 903->1395 (1388 of that is inherited at HEAD; WR-7b contributed +7), pulseKernel 1362->1580 (byte-identical to HEAD; WR-7b contributed 0), warDeployment 1106->1412 (byte-identical to HEAD; WR-7b contributed 0). NEWLY ENTERED at measured tree size: envoyErrand 2638 (1389 inherited, +1249 WR-7b), peaceTerms 1680 (1289 inherited, +391 WR-7b), roadsKernel 838 / settlementStrategy 812 / warTermination 880 (all three byte-identical to HEAD, 100% inherited). eventProse was an offender at HEAD (1334) and is deliberately ABSENT: WR-7b decomposed it to 751, under its ceiling, so the layer rule now guards it — the wave shrank the offender set from 18 to 17. THIS IS A BURN-DOWN LEDGER, NOT A LICENCE: every entry above the pre-WR-7b frozen number is debt owed to THE DECOMPOSITION WAVE, which must lower each number toward its layer ceiling and delete the entry when it crosses. Nothing here may ever be RAISED again outside an explicit chair ruling of this kind.

The generation lane is NOT a like-for-like move: it closes over the module-local memoized loadEngine(), so extracting it relocates a LAZY chunk boundary and must be re-proved against the first-paint byte-budget build tests (tests/build/vendorPdfLazy.test.js, engineChunkLazy) with a real build — out of scope for a cycle that could not run one. _decomposition_wave_war_2026_08_03: THE DECOMPOSITION WAVE, WAR TRANCHE — the other half of the burn-down the R-BLD-6 ruling above banked, same method as lane D with one addition the cycle-8 verifier demanded: BEHAVIOR-IDENTITY IS PROVED BY STRIPPED-BLOCK DIFF, not by tests alone. Every top-level declaration of the pre-split module is parsed out with its comments stripped and its `export ` prefix normalized, keyed by name; the split is accepted only when the pre-split map EQUALS the union of the family's maps — same key set, byte-identical bodies. A reorder inside a function, a changed constant or a dropped guard all red; moving a declaration between files does not, which is exactly the change being made. Each split is ALSO strict-NEUTRAL per R-BLD-9: the per-file strict map is measured before and after, the family total must be unchanged, and no debt may land on a non-family file. DELETED by the war tranche: src/domain/worldPulse/envoyErrand.js (2638 -> 691, file 1 @ 42299b07 — one head, nine leaves, the single-writer law made structural); src/domain/worldPulse/peaceTerms.js (1680 -> 765, file 2 — one head keeping the mover advanceTreaties, BOTH treaty mints and the one authority-clock boundary materializeCarriedTermSheet, over nine pure leaves catalog/primitives/appraisal/drafting/carriedSheet/graph/coalition/overlay/document; 77/77 declarations byte-identical, all 39 exports still exported from the head so no consumer import path moved, family strict total 48 before and 48 after). The two remaining war entries — pulseKernel and applyWorldPulse — are THE PULSE MOUTHS and carry an extra law: the kernel's stage ORDER and stream identity may not move, since any reordering is a same-seed shift. FILE 4 LANDED (applyWorldPulse.js 1395 -> 941, entry LOWERED not deleted): one head over six pure leaves — primitives (32) / relationshipGraph (205) / factionRoster (92) / occupationAuthority (44) / stressorMerge (36) / betrayal (48). THE HEAD KEPT, BY R-BLD-4's WRITER-FAMILY READING AND BY PIN: applyWorldPulseOutcomes (the mouth, and the file the metronome + war-intent source pins address), applyWorldPulseProposal + mintRealmVerbProposal (the two exported writers), reEmbedPrimaryDeity (the ONE file noPremadeDeityPool's allowlist permits the `deity:core:` literal in) and, with it, applyOutcomeToSettlement + applyFoodStockpileOutcomeToSettlement, which call it — moving those would have forced either a leaf->head circular import or an amendment to the deity-doctrine allowlist, and neither buys the 800 ceiling. 35/35 declarations byte-identical, all 3 exports still exported from the head, strict 31 before / 31 after and any-holes 58 before / 58 after, both REDISTRIBUTED within the family with every total untouched. STILL OVER 800 BY 141: closing that needs surgery inside applyWorldPulseOutcomes itself, which is banked debt, not this commit's work. FILE 3, pulseKernel.js, IS CLOSED AS DELIBERATELY RETAINED, NOT OWED — see the _r_bld_10 key below. The cycle-16 K-2 lane measured that the plan's stage-body extraction breaks NINE machine-enforced source-address assertions across six walkers, because the kernel is a write-sequencing spine (44/21/3 mutable-spine writes in consequence_fold/mover_planes/settlement_clock) whose stage bodies ARE the writers R-BLD-4 puts in the head. THE DECOMPOSITION WAVE therefore closes at three of four by ruling, not by deferral.
_r_bld_10_pulsekernel_banked_permanently: CHAIR RULING R-BLD-10 (2026-08-03, vetoable; recorded in docs/FABLE_VALIDATION_QUEUE.md). src/domain/worldPulse/pulseKernel.js IS BANKED PERMANENTLY AT ITS MEASURED 1580. This entry is NOT burn-down debt and must not be read as owed work by any later lane: the 800 layer ceiling was proved STRUCTURALLY UNREACHABLE, not merely expensive. THE MEASUREMENT: extracting the ENTIRE consequence_fold body — the largest stage, 718 effective of the file — still lands the head at 864, so even the maximal sanctioned move does not clear 800; clearing it would require moving consequence_fold AND mover_planes together, the two stages holding 65 of the 68 mutable-spine writes, which is the R-BLD-4 writer-family law inverted. THE PRICE OF GOING FURTHER IS THE PROMISE: the kernel's PRNG call order IS the stream identity ('a seed is a world, forever'), and the deeper rewrites that would be needed past the stage boundaries put a same-seed shift at risk for a SIZE NUMBER. That trade is refused. WHAT STILL BINDS: the number is a CEILING, not a licence — eslint reds the file the moment it grows past 1580, and tests/lint/sizeBaseline.test.js reds it the moment it SHRINKS below 1580 without this number being lowered, so a genuine future win is still banked automatically. What is retired is only the obligation to reach 800. Related, and separately recorded: the kernel carries 22 rng.fork sites (the figure of 54 that circulated in the wave's working notes was never written to the tree and is corrected here for the record).
